verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair axis for an AI meeting-notes platform, but the evidence shows no in-product scheduler or recurring job capability. Fellow offers event-driven webhooks and a REST API that a user would have to drive from their own external scheduler. The docs explicitly note that no in-product rules or trigger-action engine is documented. Webhooks are one-off event reactions, not a recurring schedule, and API building blocks earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
